verdict.rationale: Poke's docs explicitly state the API can be called programmatically from scripts/automation tools and that CI/CD pipelines or monitoring tools can trigger Poke (poke-docs-1, poke-docs-2), which supports headless/automation use. However there is no worked CI example, no dedicated CLI 'headless mode' flag, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that this works reliably in automation pipelines. Missing for 10: concrete CI/CD integration example or workflow file, documented headless execution mode beyond simple message-send, independent corroboration of automation use.
